scope: Normative audit of authored PDF knockout/opacity-mask prototype; not production integration

findings.rule: Initial alpha-source flag is false: soft masks and alpha constants specify opacity, not shape.
Knockout interpolation uses source shape separately from opacity; groups subsequently painted into knockout parents must retain separate shape.
AIS false assigns soft-mask values to opacity. AIS true assigns them to shape.

Non-isolated child of knockout parent uses parent initial backdrop. Group entry resets blend mode, alpha constants and soft mask; group exit restores previous graphics state and paints union shape with accumulated opacity.

assessment: Current authored AIS-default-false prototype model agrees with these rules. External-renderer disagreement alone does not justify replacing group shape with alpha. This is a formula audit, not full conformance proof.
